item.title: Bowman vertigo not linked to prior concussions, team says
item.description: Alex Bowman had no warning before he began feeling ill last weekend at Circuit of The Americas, according to Hendrick Motorsports President Jeff Andrews, who says the cause of what was subsequently diagnosed as vertigo remains unclear.

item.title: Malukas takes first career IndyCar pole at Phoenix
item.description: David Malukas will lead the NTT IndyCar Series field to the green for Saturday’s Good Ranchers 250 at Phoenix International Raceway, while the man he replaced at Team Penske, Will Power, will start from the back row after hitting the wall in qualifying.
